name: Get_Last_Nth_Close_Trade
summary: This EA scans all closed trade deals in the account history, filters them by optional symbol and magic number, sorts them by close time, and displays the Nth most recent closed trade's details on the chart via Comment(). It is a read-only utility that does not open or manage any positions.
summary_zh: 该EA扫描账户历史中的所有已平仓交易，可按交易品种和魔术号进行过滤，按平仓时间排序后在图表上显示第N笔最近已平仓交易的详细信息。它是一个只读工具，不执行任何开仓或仓位管理操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个历史交易查询工具。它通过遍历MT5的HistoryDeals来获取已平仓交易信息，使用DEAL_ENTRY_OUT筛选出场交易，使用DEAL_ENTRY_IN匹配对应的开仓价格和开仓时间。支持通过ENABLE_SYMBOL_FILTER和ENABLE_MAGIC_NUMBER两个布尔开关进行交易品种和魔术号过滤。排序采用冒泡排序按平仓时间降序排列，然后根据用户指定的TRADE_INDEX索引提取对应的交易详情。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，因为该EA纯粹是信息展示工具。整体逻辑清晰但存在性能隐患，如每次Tick都重复扫描全部历史记录且使用O(n²)排序算法。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a historical trade query utility. It iterates through MT5's HistoryDeals to retrieve closed trade information, filtering for exit deals using DEAL_ENTRY_OUT and matching corresponding entry prices and times using DEAL_ENTRY_IN. It supports optional filtering by symbol and magic number through two boolean switches: ENABLE_SYMBOL_FILTER and ENABLE_MAGIC_NUMBER. Sorting is done via bubble sort in descending order by close time, then the trade at the user-specified TRADE_INDEX is extracted and displayed. There is no position sizing or money management since the EA is purely an information display tool. The logic is clear but has performance concerns, such as scanning the entire deal history on every tick and using an O(n²) bubble sort algorithm.

parameters.name: ENABLE_MAGIC_NUMBER
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable magic number filter

parameters.name: ENABLE_SYMBOL_FILTER
parameters.description: 是否启用交易品种过滤

parameters.name: TRADE_INDEX
parameters.description: 要查询的已平仓交易索引（从最新开始）
parameters.description_en: Closed trade index to query (from latest)

pros: 支持按交易品种和魔术号灵活过滤，适配多策略场景
结构体设计合理，完整记录了已平仓交易的关键信息包括开仓价、平仓价、止损、止盈、盈亏等
通过DEAL_ENTRY_IN反向匹配开仓信息，确保获取完整的开仓价和开仓时间数据
pros_en: Supports flexible filtering by symbol and magic number, suitable for multi-strategy scenarios
Well-designed struct that comprehensively records key closed trade details including open price, close price, SL, TP, and profit
Reverse-matches entry deals via DEAL_ENTRY_IN to ensure complete open price and open time data
cons: 每Tick都执行完整历史扫描和排序，在交易历史较多时会造成严重性能问题
使用冒泡排序O(n²)算法，对大量历史交易效率极低
全局结构体orderHistoryDetails仅保存单条记录，无法同时保留多条查询结果，且OnTick中无条件执行查询缺乏节流控制
第二次遍历历史记录匹配开仓信息时缺少break优化，找到匹配后仍继续遍历剩余记录
cons_en: Performs full history scan and sort on every tick, causing serious performance issues when trade history is large
Uses O(n²) bubble sort algorithm, extremely inefficient for large numbers of historical trades
The global struct orderHistoryDetails only stores a single record and cannot retain multiple query results, plus OnTick executes queries unconditionally without throttling
The second history loop matching entry information lacks a break optimization, continuing to iterate after finding a match
improvements: 添加新Bar检测或定时器机制，避免每Tick重复计算，大幅提升性能
将冒泡排序替换为标准库排序或将历史记录按时间倒序直接利用HistorySelect的有序性避免排序
第二次遍历匹配开仓信息时，为每个position_ticket找到匹配后立即break跳出内循环以减少不必要的迭代
improvements_en: Add new bar detection or a timer mechanism to avoid recalculating on every tick, significantly improving performance
Replace bubble sort with standard library sorting or leverage the inherent ordering of HistorySelect to avoid sorting altogether
Break out of the inner loop immediately after finding the matching entry deal for each position_ticket to reduce unnecessary iterations

risk_points: 该EA为只读工具，不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
频繁的历史扫描在高交易量账户上可能导致终端卡顿或CPU占用过高
risk_points_en: This EA is a read-only utility that executes no trades, posing no financial risk
Frequent history scanning on high-volume accounts may cause terminal lag or excessive CPU usage

summary_en: This EA scans all closed trade deals in the account history, filters them by optional symbol and magic number, sorts them by close time, and displays the Nth most recent closed trade's details on the chart via Comment(). It is a read-only utility that does not open or manage any positions.
